title: Folder sizes
description:
Walk a folder with `std::filesystem` and total the size by file type.

```
assets/: 14 files, 3.2 MB
  .png  9 files  2.9 MB
  .wav  3 files  0.3 MB
  .txt  2 files  2 KB
largest: assets/music/theme.wav
```
hints: `std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator` works like the `directory_iterator` from lesson 5.04, but also walks into every subfolder. Give it an error code so problems are reported instead of thrown: `for (const auto& entry : fs::recursive_directory_iterator{ root, ec })`, then check `ec` afterwards.
`entry.is_regular_file()` and `entry.file_size()`; pass an `std::error_code` so a locked file does not throw (lesson 5.04).
Format sizes with a small function that divides by 1024 until the number is small.
requirements: Group by lower-case extension in a `std::map`.
Create a small folder tree at the start so the program has something to scan.
